description: [Compliance & counterparty] Screen a buyer or consignee against US export-control lists before selling or shipping. Use when a deal may involve US-origin items or technology. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/export-screen

country.description: Optional country (ISO2 or name) to boost matches with that address country

lists.description: Optional comma-separated list codes to restrict: EL,DPL,UVL,MEU,DTC,ISN,SDN,SSI,CMIC,PLC,MBS,CAP

name.description: Company or person name to screen

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: screen_export_control
title: US Export Control Screening (Consolidated Screening List) ($0.02)
